facts.statement: Builder requires nonzero UInt32 PID, URL at most255B with case-insensitive http(s) prefix and limited first-host-character checks, drive-absolute launcher path4..259B,1..10decimal archive-size bytes giving1..268435456, and exactly32hex MD5 bytes. Field guard excludes pipes/quotes/controls/DEL and leading/trailing SP; this is not full URL or filesystem validation.

Copies URL/path, replaces every internal SP with pipe, and formats decimal PID plus URL/path/original archive-size text/original MD5 with single SP separators. Leading zeros and MD5 letter case are preserved; the CString terminator is outside returned logical bytes.

Selected caller builds a parent-creation-time handoff event and uses ShellExecuteExA runas with mask0x440 and directory from launcher location, then a100ms timer. The shared codec neither creates the event nor executes this lifecycle.
